name: uaippt
description: Gerador de apresentações PowerPoint (.pptx) no padrão oficial SENAI / Fatesg com Motion Design (Manim e Blender) e skill para AI Coding Agents.

scripts.build-skill: python -c "import zipfile, pathlib; z = zipfile.ZipFile('uaippt.skill', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [z.write(f, 'uaippt/' + f.relative_to('.agents/skills/uaippt').as_posix()) for f in pathlib.Path('.agents/skills/uaippt').rglob('*') if f.is_file() and not any(p in f.parts for p in ['__pycache__', '.manim_cache', '.tmp_'])]; print('uaippt.skill packaged successfully!')"

author: Prof. Msc. Ujeverson Tavares <ujeverson@gmail.com>
